economy.plainEnglish: Supplies pay for buildings and units. Shells are a different budget for the guns. A barrage must not bankrupt the base, and a barracks must not eat ammunition.
economy.whyGame: One shared float makes those two spends fight, and a client subtract still diverges from the host.

expansions.title: A fire mission
expansions.detail: The gun subtracts a shell. It does not touch Supplies unless a second call says the shell also costs money.

expansions.title: The board
expansions.detail: Scoring reads the score. It does not read the stock.

scoring.plainEnglish: The server adds the medal. A kill, a capture, and a fire mission that hits a marked target can be different rows. A miss, a reveal, and a supply spend do not award. The board only displays the server number.
